arguments.content: Preference read review — preserving policy when normalizing inputs (P1). A passing test suite can conceal a contract regression when a normalization change switches a public adapter from its repository's policy-owning method to a lower-level primitive and the new tests assert that primitive's failure behavior. In this review, Preferences.read -> read_preferences switched from read_resilient to read_once while trimming the ID; public-path probes confirmed that second/third-attempt recovery vanished despite green tests. Review delegation changes against the pre-existing public contract, and test recovery, bounded exhaustion, and permanent failures independently of the changed implementation. Keep normalization upstream of the existing policy boundary.
